rules.guns: All guns use the Laser weapon rules; Starships are common rides.

rules.martial_arts: Martial Arts is universal in this Flick; use an Ancient Martial Style instead.

rules.weapons: Martial Arts/Gunslinger may be replaced by Sword Fighter; Marksman may be replaced by Archer; guns may be replaced by period weapons.
rules.rides: Horses use Stunt and count as Bikes.

rules.super_tag: The Super Tag grants one additional Super Feat and a weakness; weakness causes Powerless.

rules.special_role: A Special Role acts as Role, Trope, and Job; grant 2 Attribute Points, 14 assigned Skill Points, 6 free Skill Points, and up to 3 listed Feats.

rules.character_creation: Project Medusa supplies pre-generated Heroes and instructs Directors to use the Corebook; it introduces no new player Role, Trope, Feat, or Gear option.

werewolf.grants: Gain Lycanthrope and swap one Role Feat for another Monstrous Feat.

multiverse.name: From the Multiverse
multiverse.grants: Access to Multiverse Feats after establishing a connection with the Multiverse.

angel.name: Angel
angel.grants: Gain Celestial and swap one Role Feat for another Otherworldly Feat.

demon.name: Demon
demon.grants: Gain Infernal and swap one Role Feat for another Otherworldly Feat.

zombie.name: Zombie
zombie.grants: Replace a Role or Trope Feat with Undead when Smart Zombies are allowed.

virtual.name: Virtual
virtual.grants: One Virtual Feat replacing a Role or Trope Feat.

animal.name: Animal
animal.grants: Animal Feats; swap any number of normal Feats at creation.

beast.name: Beast
beast.grants: One Beast Form; the Form replaces a Superpower when applicable.

robot.name: Robot
robot.grants: Android Feat, replacing one Role or Trope Feat.

mythic.name: Mythic
mythic.grants: Access to Mythic Feats, Artifacts, and Divine Patrons.

everyday.name: Everyday
everyday.grants: Everyday Feats; this tag represents a powerless human in Only Human.

toon.name: Toon
toon.grants: Swap one or two Role Feats for Toon Feats.

variant.name: Variant
variant.grants: Swap one Role or Trope Feat for a Variant Feat.

chameleon.name: Chameleon
chameleon.summary: Hide and strike from ambush; gain Sticky Tongue.

boar.name: Boar
boar.summary: Gain Help for Endure and running attacks; gain Curved Tusks.

cat.name: Cat
cat.summary: Free Re-rolls to Stunt and resist falls; gain Retractable Claws.

rodent.name: Rodent
rodent.summary: Free Re-rolls to Stunt, Dexterity, and Stealth; gain a tail-hand and Bite.

turtle.name: Turtle
turtle.summary: Gain resilience and ranged defense; gain Shell Shock.

rabbit.name: Rabbit
rabbit.summary: Free Re-rolls and Help for leaps and running; gain Kick.

lion.name: Lion
lion.summary: Free Re-rolls to Force, Fight, and Leadership; gain Fangs and Claws.

wolf.name: Wolf
wolf.summary: Free Re-rolls to Detect and Awareness; call the pack and gain Fangs and Claws.

bat.name: Bat
bat.summary: Hear in darkness and fly; gain Clawed Feet.

mole.name: Mole
mole.summary: Dig and destroy barriers; gain projectile defense and Long Claws.

bird_of_prey.name: Bird of Prey
bird_of_prey.summary: Fly and carry a Hero; gain aerial chase and defense benefits.

shark.name: Shark
shark.summary: Gain Force/Endure and underwater benefits; gain Jaws.
